title: Sharp $A_α$-Spectral Conditions for Odd $[1,b]$-Factors When $α>1/2$
summary: We solve, for all sufficiently large even orders, the problem proposed by Chen et al. on sharp $A_α$-spectral conditions for the existence of odd $[1,b]$-factors when $α>1/2$. Chen et al. showed that every connected graph of even order $n$ with no odd $[1,b]$-factor has $A_α$-spectral radius at most $\max_{1\le s\le k}ρ_α(G_s)$, where $G_s=K_s\nabla\left(K_{n-(b+1)s-1}\cup(bs+1)K_1\right)$ and $k=\lfloor(n-2)/(b+1)\rfloor$.
